answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 10 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 820 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The walnut of the design is public, the cipher of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the trellis of honest work is what finally pays.
